summary: Resolve references across versioned snapshots, tracking which namespace/location/hash they match.

traps.quote: The initial index is snapshot 0. Applying atomic batch i produces snapshot i.
traps.consequence: Off-by-one errors: solution processes wrong snapshots or crashes on edge case start=len(snapshots).
traps.guard: Map batch index to snapshot: snapshots[k] produces snapshot k+1. Snapshot count = len(snapshots)+1.

traps.quote: form candidates by prepending the longest through shortest prefix of context
traps.consequence: Solution checks shortest prefix first; selects wrong candidate (ambiguity in direction).
traps.guard: Generate candidates with prefix length n, n-1, ..., 1, 0. Check in this order; select first match.

traps.quote: a function match changes the namespace to "function"
traps.consequence: Solution returns input namespace even after matching function; output namespace wrong.
traps.guard: Track namespace changes: for value refs finding function match, return ("located", "function", ...).

traps.quote: At each such snapshot, if its exact key exists, its hash becomes the entry's current hash
traps.consequence: Solution returns original reference hash for located status; doesn't track snapshot-level updates.
traps.guard: For location-authoritative refs, re-check entry at each snapshot and update hash if key exists.

traps.quote: start is an integer from 0 through len(snapshots)
traps.consequence: Solution crashes or skips reference with start=len(snapshots), only checking final snapshot.
traps.guard: Handle start values 0 to len(snapshots) inclusive; process from snapshot start until end.

traps.quote: text consists of zero or more module identifiers followed by a terminal. Any violation makes invalid.
traps.consequence: Solution accepts malformed text (e.g., leading uppercase, @@ suffix) or rejects valid edge cases.
traps.guard: Validate: identifiers [a-zA-Z0-9_]+, modules start [a-z], types start [A-Z], suffix @N only on function/value.

input_shape: initial entries, list of snapshot batches (updates), and references with start times; at most 200k each.
output_shape: List of 4-tuples (status, namespace, location, hash) per reference, in input order.
invariants: Each reference is processed starting at its start snapshot; once matched, it's location-authoritative thereafter.
Deleted entries (hash=None in updates) cease to exist; location-authoritative hashes may change per snapshot.
Value references search value candidates first, then function candidates (changing namespace if matched).
max_scale: 200k snapshots, 200k entries, 200k updates, 200k references; 1M induced candidate names total.
